programme.desc: Luis le paga a la esposa de Joel para alquilar su vientre, pero ella cae en coma. Por otro lado, Hilario es un gaucho que maneja con mucha destreza las boleadoras y los tambores.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Poseído por mamá; Fish spa chupitos
programme.desc: Orlando pide que su hermano Neifry deje de comportarse como su madre fallecida. Karla se infecta con una bacteria al hacerse un tratamiento de belleza con peces. Ahora exige que cierren el spa.

programme.title: Enemigo íntimo
programme.desc: Roxana y sus hombres ejecutan el plan en dos fases, pero deben contar con la ayuda y complicidad de muchos. Martín es uno de los colaboradores esenciales. La policía acorrala a Rodiles.

programme.title: Enemigo íntimo
programme.desc: Roxana Rodiles da una vuelta de timón a su estrategia y sorprende a todos. Martín es algo más que un socio. Ferrer busca una razón para que ella, repentinamente, abandone el negocio.

programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos
programme.desc: Plutarco decide poner a prueba a Constanza y usa sus dos identidades para invitarla a salir. Ella tendrá que elegir a quién le cancela, a su ex o a su amor virtual, Marcelo.

programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos
programme.desc: Luis no le dice la verdad a Jimena y le pide 100 días. No tiene a dónde ir. Emiliano y Plutarco son sus amigos y cómplices de la situación que estalla frente a todos.

programme.title: Juego de villanos
programme.desc: Dieciocho villanos icónicos compiten por el título de "El Emperador de los Villanos" y 200 mil dólares. Entre desafíos, inmunidades, alianzas y traiciones, solo uno alcanza la cima.

programme.title: Falsa identidad
programme.desc: El líder de los Gaona queda sin aliados y cae en la trampa de Mateo, quien lo entrega a su hija. Circe no va a tener piedad con su padre, pues quiere cobrarle todo lo que le ha hecho.

programme.title: Falsa identidad
programme.sub-title: El duelo final de los Gaona
programme.desc: La guerra entre padre e hija llega a su momento culminante, donde solo un Gaona puede matar a otro Gaona. Uno de ellos muerde el anzuelo. Isabel está al borde de la muerte.

programme.title: Victoria
programme.desc: Victoria se prepara para celebrar su 25 aniversario de bodas. A pesar de que Enrique, su esposo, la desprecia, vive con entusiasmo. Lo que ella no imagina es la terrible noticia que está a punto de recibir.

programme.title: Victoria
programme.desc: Victoria interrumpe la fiesta y sorprende a Enrique al confesarle que descubrió su secreto. Jerónimo conoce a Valeria y puede conseguir información muy valiosa para su trabajo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carlos demanda a Marcela, su madrastra, para quitarle la custodia de su padre enfermo. Daniel sacrifica burros para preparar una gelatina capaz de sanar a su hijo, pero su esposa se opone.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Juan está convencido de que es una mujer, su esposa, Liscar, le exige que vaya a terapia. Ariana tiene muchas cucarachas en su casa y como su amiga Claudia les tiene miedo, la demanda.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su esposo quiere despedir a la doula por insistir en un embarazo al margen de médicos. Los celos y favoritismo de su novia y supervisora fueron la causa de que la tuviera que despedir.

programme.desc: Por presión de su esposo se hizo una operación gástrica, ahora siente que no es ella y quiere volver a engordar. Para cumplir con el testamento de su hermana deben sacrificar a un perro.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.desc: This light-hearted police drama follows a sheltered deaf woman who is about to start her first real job with the FBI. When she is given the tedious task of analyzing fingerprints, Sue is disappointed but doesn't remain there for long. An FBI agent discovers her ability to read lips and promotes Sue to an elite surveillance team. Suddenly, Sue and her hearing dog, Levi, are "G-Men," involved in a lot more action than they bargained for. This series is loosely based on the real-life deaf FBI agent Sue Thomas.

Learning of the suit, high-strung FBI agent Bill Maxwell convinces Ralph to help him fight crime. Ralph's girlfriend, attorney Pam Davidson, also knows of his secret life as a superhero.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises.

programme.desc: Rich Eisen leads a cast of NFL talent through four hours of pregame hype, prepping viewers for the kickoffs of Sunday's games. The latest news from around the league, reports from game sites and interviews with players and coaches are featured, and insider Ian Rapoport provides late-breaking news.

programme.title: NFL GameDay Live
programme.desc: Expanding on NFL Network's "GameDay" programming on Sundays during football season, "GameDay Live" updates viewers on what's happening throughout the league. Beginning with kickoff of early-afternoon events and continuing throughout late-afternoon contests, the studio show offers nearly immediate highlights of scoring and other notable plays. But the program is about more than the action; it intersperses highlights of press conferences, interviews with players and coaches, and live reports by announcers at game sites.

He awakens, remembering nothing and struggles to do right by his devout wife, Petunia (Ethel Waters), while an angel known as the General (Kenneth Spencer) and the devil's son, Lucifer Jr. (Rex Ingram), fight for his soul.

As Calloway and his band prepare for their maiden performance at the Brass Hat, the vengeful Minnie asks Boss Mason (George Wiltshire) -- the thuggish owner of a competing club -- to put a hit on her man.

As Macreedy's investigation deepens, hostility turns to violence -- and to imminent danger for the mysterious and inquisitive stranger.
